newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HEINEKEN SHARES EXTEND LOSSES, SLIDE 4 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HEINEKEN SHARES EXTEND LOSSES, SLIDE 4 PCT.

text.p: Shares in Dutch brewer Heineken NV took a further hammering on Monday after losing 11 percent on Friday on a profit warning from the firm.
By 0805 GMT the stock was down 12.50 guilders or 3.9 percent at 310.00. The stock went ex-dividend today, accounting for 1.50 guilders of the fall.

On Friday, the group posted a six percent rise in first half 1996 net profit to 297 million guilders and warned full-year net would be somewhat lower than 1995's 664 million guilders, blaming stagnant European markets.
Chairman Karel Vuursteen also warned double digit profit growth over the next three years could not be guaranteed.
